name: 70525 · Church Point, LA
findings: ZIP 70525 (Church Point) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70525 (Church Point) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
